llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requested credentials are consistent with a pay-per-use medical-record structuring tool that calls billing and optional OCR/STT providers — nothing obviously malicious — but packaging metadata mismatches and PHI-handling (external APIs/billing) warrant careful review before use.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name and description (EMR structuring) align with the code and docs: it parses text, supports OCR/STT providers, and integrates billing via skillpay.me. Required credentials (SkillPay API key and Skill ID) and optional OCR/STT keys match the stated monetization and external-service integrations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and scripts instruct the agent to run the included Python script which extracts patient info and calls external services (skillpay.me and optionally OCR/STT providers). This is in-scope for the stated purpose, but it does mean PHI may be transmitted to third-party services depending on configuration; the SKILL.md advocates encryption/audit logging but the runtime will call external endpoints when OCR/STT or billing are used.

dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no automated install that downloads arbitrary code at runtime — the skill is instruction/code-only with bundled scripts. No remote install URLs or unusual extract steps were present.

dimensions.detail: Requested environment variables (SKILLPAY_API_KEY, SKILLPAY_SKILL_ID) and optional OCR/STT keys are proportionate to billing and external-service usage. However, the registry metadata reported 'Required env vars: none' while SKILL.md and code require billing keys — this packaging inconsistency should be resolved. Also be aware that optional OCR/STT providers will require provider keys and may receive PHI.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills, and includes only scripts that run on demand. The upload-to-clawhub script can upload the skill if provided a user token, but it requires explicit user action and a token parameter.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims (EMR parsing + pay-per-use billing). Before installing: 1) Fix the packaging metadata mismatch (registry says no env vars but SKILL.md and scripts require SKILLPAY_API_KEY and SKILLPAY_SKILL_ID). 2) Review the full process_record.py (the file was partially shown) to confirm no unexpected network calls or data leakage beyond billing/OCR/STT endpoints. 3) Test only with dummy/no-PHI data until you verify where data is sent and stored. 4) Understand SkillPay's privacy practices — billing calls may log identifiers; avoid sending identifiable PHI to services without confirmed contractual/legal protections (HIPAA). 5) If you will enable OCR/STT, prefer local/open-source providers (e.g., local Tesseract/Whisper) or vetted cloud services with appropriate agreements. 6) Do not run the upload-to-clawhub.sh unless you intend to publish and you control the API token. If possible, request the publisher to correct registry metadata and provide a full untruncated source for final review.
